prompt: I want to coordinate 3 agents (Claude, Codex, and OpenCode) to fan out a refactor across independent files in this repo, then have one of them integrate and finalize when everyone's done. Walk me through exactly what you'd do first as the lead -- which coord_* tools you'd call, in what order, with what key arguments -- before any teammate starts editing.
assertions: Plan calls coord_create_run (or coord_status/coord_list_runs first, then coord_create_run) before creating any tasks
Plan creates a complete task graph -- at least 2 independent teammate lanes plus 1 dependent lead/integration task -- via coord_create_task before starting or joining teammate workers
Plan explicitly says the lead must NOT claim an umbrella task covering the teammates' work
Plan calls coord_status to verify the board/roster before considering kickoff complete
Plan does not fabricate tool names or arguments not present in the skill (no hallucinated coord_* tools)
